name: Office After-Hours Phantom Load Combination (Building-only)
trigger_logic: commercial building or office tower active
anti_triggers: tenant boundary fully aligned with metering
combined_hypothesis: After-hours phantom load may dominate measured energy intensity precisely because BMS schedules drift while tenant boundary control is unclear about who is responsible. Capital will be misdirected at HVAC equipment when the real lever is governance + scheduling.
strategic_risk: Owner allocates retrofit capital while the savings would land on the tenant side or be evaporated by schedule drift the next quarter.
financial_exposure: phantom load >20% of measured EUI hidden in after-hours
value capture leaks across owner-tenant boundary
tad_action: VALIDATE CONTROL BOUNDARY + AUDIT BMS SCHEDULE + REBOUND TENANT BOUNDARY + PROHIBIT ROI
allowed_language: A bounded structural framing is admissible: the phantom load story may be a governance/scheduling story disguised as an equipment opportunity.
falsification: BMS schedule documented and trended, tenant boundary aligned with metering, AND after-hours phantom load characterized below threshold.
tests: commercial-building acceptance bundle should surface this combination when BMS drift, tenant boundary and after-hours load remain unresolved
must NOT activate in warehouse, manufacturing, cold-chain cases (anti-pattern protection by tenant_operator_boundary_unresolved)
combination must require run-level adjudication before downstream strategic use
